mechanism: A normalized identity query with an explicit no-correspondence alternative, preserving a strong fitted RGB reference and adding only a bounded native-cue contrast. Recover old identities before new IDs are returned; ambiguity must be allowed to reject a match.
setting: November new pseudo-IR MFT, frozen original detector/point streams, FP32 BN-neck RGB/native features. Original direct RGB fine-tune plus ByteTrack remains Test29.529; ordinary representation/calibration improvements are not multimodal novelty.
data: Exact reconstructed local pair bank plus the preserved Train-only chronological long bank. Match original query/label/lag/geometry and use actual native candidate crops including perturbed boxes and two backgrounds. No Dev/Test fitting.
native_alignment: Equal-video orthogonal Procrustes from each native post-neck encoder to the frozen RGB teacher post-neck vectors, fit on11967 paired Train observations only. Preserve within-native cosine; record the map as an ordinary control.
RGB_core: For each detector frontend and head seed, retain the ordinary RGB pair model selected from all72 complete Dev snapshots at executed36 epochs. No Test selection. Native RGB/IR heads share exactly the same frozen core and ordinary post-neck prior.
RGB_query_prior: Train-only four-parameter conditional softmax: real-candidate logit=t*frozen_RGB_pair_logit+a*RGB_postneck_cosine; null logit=b+c*log(1+candidate_count). Fit convex weighted CE using L-BFGS-B, t in[0,10],a in[0,50],b/c in[-20,20],L2 coefficient0.0001. This deterministic ordinary calibration is not a neural epoch/seed claim.
null_training: Reproducible15% removal of the true current candidate, setting its query target to null; actual no-match queries remain null. Training-only masks/labels never enter inference. Equal video/regime weighting.
base_features: Original23 RGB/point features plus RGB post-neck cosine, its margin over other current targets and its margin over other past candidates:26 dimensions. Long appearance-only regime uses the already registered missing-motion masks.
cue_features: 9 dimensions: native-native cosine, native-past/RGB-current cosine, RGB-past/native-current cosine, both within-observation native/RGB agreements, native row/column competition margins, and source/target cue contrast. RGB reference uses the corresponding teacher RGB evidence. Equal-size extra-RGB cue uses the equally trained native RGB encoder.
formula: Keep frozen RGB real/null logits. Add4*tanh((f(base,cue)-f(base,RGB_reference))/4) only to real-candidate logits, then normalize real and null alternatives together. Zero or unavailable new increment exactly retains the complete calibrated RGB query posterior.
fit_heads: Both fixed detector frontends x RGB/IR auxiliary cue x three seeds =12 matched residual fits. CNN encoders already execute36 epochs; no new pixel encoder fitting in this stage.
sampling: Half local/half long query batches; uniform Train video within regime; replacement query draws and identical matched-cue random masks.
loss: Query CE weighted by0.05+(1-frozen_RGB_probability_of_correct_target)^2, normalized in batch; +0.02*p_RGB_correct^2*mean(new_increment^2) preservation +0.001*mean(new_increment^2). All RGB core/prior gradients disabled.
stopping: At common18 and subsequent6-epoch checks extend every matched fit if any complete Dev combination improves best HOTA by>0.2pp over best through12 epochs earlier; otherwise stop, cap36. Earliest checkpoint wins ties.
association: Keep current/past-only inference. Compare all current proposals, explicit null, current-stage candidates and competing retained identities. Freeze concrete replay thresholds before Dev, count opened edges, preserve original lifecycle when the new routes are disabled. An already returned identity cannot be rewritten.
required_ablations: Exact zero native increment retaining RGB real/null posterior
interpretation: BN conditioning, native encoders, Procrustes, softmax rejection and generic memory are known components. Credit only an actual new-IR-specific coupled mechanism with complete Dev/Test positive removal gains beyond the matched RGB control. The>=+5 HOTA and2-3 contribution goal is unfinished.
availability: A native IR increment requires source and target actual IR crop contrast>=0.15; RGB increments are always available. This flat-crop gate is not the learned cross-modal agreement signal. Padding never supplies evidence.
